verses.text: Jerusalem was once full of people,
We [PRS] weep bitterly all night long,
The people of Judah have been ◄exiled/forced to go to other countries►
The roads to Zion Hill are empty [PRS]
Our enemies have conquered the city,
Jerusalem was a beautiful city,
The people of Jerusalem are sad and scattered,
The people of [PRS] Jerusalem have sinned very much;
The city has become filthy because of [PRS] the sins that the people have committed;
Our enemies have taken away all our treasures,
The people of the city groan
You people who pass by,
It is as though he sent a fire from heaven [MTY]
He caused the sins that we have committed to be like a heavy load for us to carry;
Yahweh looked at our mighty soldiers
I weep because of all those things;
We people of [PRS] Jerusalem reach out our hands to get help,
But what Yahweh has done to us is fair,
We pleaded with our allies to help us,
Yahweh, see that we are suffering very much.
People have heard us while we groaned,
Yahweh, see all the evil things that they have done
